root_cause: Two separate round-1 tempo leaks in the movement planner (_assign_units_to_objectives). (1) An uncontrolled home objective scores far above forward objectives in the planner: WEIGHT_HOME_UNDEFENDED (+9) plus the reachable-this-turn bonus beat a 3x larger VP value (s7468 P1: home 38.1 with expected_vp 2 vs obj_nml_1 24.4 / obj_center 14.7 with expected_vp 6). The greedy pass 2 therefore spends the nearest DURABLE unit (Custodian Guard Gamma) on home first, even though no enemy can reach home before our next turn, and the leftover pass then sends a second Custodian unit (Alpha) to 'reinforce' home as well (support pass: high eval.priority + short distance). Replaying the alternative (Gamma Advances to the centre): B gained +4 VP on the round-1 'Smoke and Mirrors' primary from the forward position; Alpha still took home in B. (2) The support/leftover pass (_find_best_remaining_objective) only ever returns 'move', never 'advance', so a spare unit on a multi-turn trip walks even when its own capture candidate (RACE-1 long-trip test) says Advancing saves a whole turn at no shooting cost (s7451 P2 Gamma: support to a contested centre, 3 turns walking vs 2 Advancing). The older findings s7412 / s7411 no longer reproduce on V9 (the decider already Advances to the centre instead of going home).
fix_summary: R1-HOME-LAST (FIX_R1_HOME_CAPTURE, round 1 only). (a) Our home objective that is uncontrolled, has nobody en route, cannot be reached by any enemy unit (on-board reach or reserves) by the end of the enemy's next turn (reuses _keeper_release_threat) and is not paid for by a home-specific card (primary hold_home_required, Defend Stronghold home hint, Extend Battle Lines; 'any objective' cards like Burden of Trust do not block) is captured LAST: in pass 2 a non-fragile unit whose home candidate comes up is skipped while it has a forward capture worth at least the home VP that pass 2 would send it on (needs OC, not DIM-RETURNS/TOO-LATE/RACE-SKIP/LONE-TRIP). After pass 2 home goes to the best unit the plan left spare (non-deferred first, else a deferred unit that found nothing forward); with no spare unit at all, the deferred unit whose forward trip was worth least comes back to home (its forward OC need re-opens), so home is never left open by this fix when a unit could take it. Fragile units, HOLD_OBJECTIVE earmarks, holders/keepers and rounds 2-5 are untouched. (b) In round 1 a support/leftover trip whose capture candidate for that objective is an Advance (RACE-1: Advancing saves a turn, no shooting/charge lost) Advances when OC on arrival matters (race_lost) or no unit of the plan gets there first; joining a unit that arrives first in an uncontested race stays a Normal move (keeper_release lesson). Every change prints [R1_HOME_CAPTURE].

fires: Counted from stdout of the same-seed replays (both players, round-1 movement; the horizon ends after round 2 and the fix is round-1 only). Decision-changing lines: s7468 p1 finding 5 (3x 'not sending ... home yet' for Gamma/Alpha/Beta in one plan, 1x 'Alpha takes it (spare)', 1x opponent Kommandos support ADVANCES); s7451 p2 finding 1 (Gamma support ADVANCES); s7412 1 (opponent Custodian Guard Alpha support ADVANCES; plus 1 info line 'captured as before — Blade Champion can reach it'); s7411 0; guardrails: s7404 2 (Ork Kommandos, Mek support ADVANCES), s7468 p2 1 (Mek support ADVANCES), s7451 2_1 0, s7420 2 (Chaplain on Bike, Logan Grimnar support ADVANCES), s7422 1 (Ancient in Terminator Armour support ADVANCES). About 0-2 support-Advance changes per game per army and at most one home deferral plan per player per game; never fires after round 1.
risks: Round 1 only, so in rounds 2-5 the planner behaves exactly as the base; the lasting effect is positional: one more durable unit starts round 2 a full turn further forward, and the round-2 primary + secondary positions (centre/NML cards, Engage on All Fronts, Behind Enemy Lines, Smoke and Mirrors-style eot positional scoring, Burden of Trust's per-objective count) benefit for the rest of the game, which is the opposite of the round-2 FAR-TRIP/OVERCOMMIT failure (units held back). Risks over a full game: (1) home is taken by a weaker or slower spare unit (or, when every spare was assigned elsewhere, by the deferred unit with the least forward value); if that spare is later pulled off by the COORD-4 attack conversion, home can be open in round 2 — the threat test guarantees no enemy can reach it before our next turn, so the cost is bounded by one round of home VP, and the base round-2 planner re-weights an undefended home (+9) immediately. Deep-strike/infiltrate threats that arrive in round 2 for the player going second are covered by _keeper_release_threat (reserves from round 2 count). (2) Home-specific secondaries (Defend Stronghold, Extend Battle Lines) and primaries requiring home keep the base behaviour; but a primary that pays MORE for home in later rounds than the forward objective (vp_value is priced at the next scoring point) could make the round-1 forward choice slightly wrong. (3) Forward units are more exposed in rounds 2-3 (more casualties feeding the enemy's kill secondaries); mitigated because only non-fragile units are deferred and forward targets exclude hopeless races and lone fragile trips. (4) The support-Advance part also changes characters/support units (Logan Grimnar, Ancient, Mek) to Advance in round 1 when no enemy is within M+12" and nothing is in weapon range — they lose a charge they could not have made anyway, but arriving early at a race the enemy wins can feed a melee unit into a bad round-2 fight; joining an uncontested objective a unit reaches first stays a Normal move. (5) Not value-checked over full games: only the one-round decision checks above were run; the 36-seed E values are for the alternatives this fix reproduces.
